Play Minecraft Dungeons II now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6004acpDM

Step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your gameplay to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends in couch, online, and mixed co-op, or find allies through matchmaking. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them—or lose the Overworld to their corruption.

Play TOEM 2 now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6009acTaB

Grab your camera and adventure through cozy environments, uncover hidden paths, check out scenic viewpoints, and help out new friends! 

TOEM 2 was crafted to be welcoming for both returning fans of TOEM and those who want to jump in for the first time. Experience it at your own pace with no time limits or tricky requirements for full completion. Listen to music on a bench, smell the flowers, admire the sights, and enjoy.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Tetris® 99 57th MAXIMUS CUP event runs from 12 a.m. PT on October 2 to 11:59 p.m. PT on October 5. To participate, you’ll need to be a Nintendo Switch Online member* and play the Tetris 99 online mode during the event period. You’ll earn event points based on your placement in each match. Once you’ve accumulated a total of 100 event points, a new theme will unlock, featuring art, music and Tetrimino designs inspired by the Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game** for the Nintendo Switch 2 system!

*Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/purchase-terms/ 
 
**Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave rated T for Teen by the ESRB.
